unit.title: Unit 0 — Build vmwalk, a Bounded Virtual-Address Translator
unit.scope: A self-contained engineering kickoff; it is not an MIT lab and does not reproduce the MIT 6.S081 curriculum.
learning_objectives: Implement a small address-translation model from a precise behavioral contract.
Separate modeled operating-system outcomes from malformed input and program failure.
Enforce bounds and invariants in portable C11.
Build deterministic tests and reproducible, explicitly labeled evidence.

unit_completion_requires: All required learner deliverables are present.
A worker-harness-controlled validator passes a clean build and the deterministic test command.
Independent fixtures confirm the specified behavior, bounds, diagnostics, and exit statuses.
The examiner-only rubric is applied with no blocking condition.
completion_policy.course_completion_policy: Not defined by this kickoff. Later jobs must retrieve and classify authorized materials, expand official units, and validate each required unit before any whole-course claim.
